01 · Core Framework

Swarms Python

The original Swarms framework in Python with full backwards compatibility with LangChain, AutoGen, and other popular frameworks.

Get StartedDocumentation
from swarms import Agent, SequentialWorkflow

# Agent 1: The Researcher
researcher = Agent(
    agent_name="Researcher",
    system_prompt="Your job is to research...",
    model_name="gpt-4o-mini",
)

# Agent 2: The Writer
writer = Agent(
    agent_name="Writer",
    system_prompt="Your job is to write...",
    model_name="gpt-4o-mini",
)

# Create workflow
workflow = SequentialWorkflow(
    agents=[researcher, writer]
)
final_post = workflow.run("AI history")
print(final_post)

Press Run to see the example output.

02 · Swarms Cloud

Swarms API

Build, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade multi-agent systems in the cloud

Get StartedDocumentation
import requests

payload = {
    "agent_config": {
        "agent_name": "Research Analyst",
        "description": "Expert in analyzing research data",
        "system_prompt": "You are a Research Analyst...",
        "model_name": "gpt-4o-mini",
        "max_tokens": 8192,
        "temperature": 0.7
    },
    "task": "Analyze the impact of AI on healthcare"
}

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.swarms.world/v1/agent/completions",
    headers={"x-api-key": "your-api-key"},
    json=payload
)
print(response.json())

Press Run to see the example output.

03 · Rust Framework

Swarms-RS

Ultra-fast, memory-safe, and production-ready multi-agent framework built in Rust for maximum performance and reliability.

Get StartedDocumentation
use swarms_rs::llm::provider::openai::OpenAI;
use swarms_rs::structs::concurrent_workflow::ConcurrentWorkflow;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let client = OpenAI::from_url(
        base_url, api_key
    ).set_model("deepseek-chat");

    let workflow = ConcurrentWorkflow::builder()
        .name("Trading Strategy")
        .agents(vec![...])
        .build();

    let result = workflow
        .run("BTC/USD").await?;
    println!("{result}");
    Ok(())
}

Press Run to see the example output.

Product·Oct 17, 2026

Introducing the Explorer: Live Growth Metrics for the Swarms Marketplace

The new Explorer page at swarms.world/explorer shows how the Swarms Marketplace is growing in real time: products, agents, prompts, tools, sellers, launches, tokenized listings, creator revenue, and trading volume. Here is what each number means and how builders can use it.

Product·Oct 14, 2026

Swarms Launchpad Update: Now Built on Meteora DBC, With $SWARMS Pairs and 80% Faster Launches

The Swarms Launchpad now launches tokenized agents and prompts directly on Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve. Pair your token with $SWARMS, earn creator fees in $SWARMS, keep earning after graduation, and launch about 80% faster.

Product·Oct 12, 2026

Dynamic Model Pricing on the Swarms API: Every Model at Its Own Price

The Swarms API no longer charges one flat token rate for every model. Each model is now billed at its provider's price plus a 15% service fee, the MCP and web scraper fees are gone, the search fee shows up in usage.total_cost, and a new /v1/models/pricing endpoint prices any model. Here is what changed, what it costs, and which endpoint outputs are different.
